newsitem.title: USA: Millennium sells some offshore units.
newsitem.headline: Millennium sells some offshore units.

text.p: Millennium Chemicals Inc said Wednesday it has sold several of its offshore companies, which mostly hold sterling-denominated deposits, for about 190 million pounds sterling.
Millenium, in an announcement from London, said sales proceeds, which approximate the book value of the companies, will be used to reduce bank debt.
The companies sold became part of the Millenium Chemicals group in connection with its spin-off from Hanson Plc, in October, it said.
William Landuyt, chairman and chief executive officer of Millenniun, said the company was pleased to have simplified its financial structure through the transaction.

"While the approximately $305 million of cash proceeds will not affect our net debt position, the transaction will reduce our gross debt to total capitalization ratio as of December 31, 1996 from 65 percent to 62 percent and should be seen as a positive step by debt rating agencies," he said.
